requirements.title: CFI_dim_t is a C structure typedef with required lower_bound, extent, and sm members
requirements.source: S18.5.2 p1 type and members; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF531.
requirements.definition: CFI_dim_t is a typedef name for a C structure that contains CFI_index_t lower_bound, CFI_index_t extent, and CFI_index_t sm members.

pending.cfi-dim-t-typedef-structure: Compile a C unit including ISO_Fortran_binding.h, declare CFI_dim_t dim initialized by separate assignments, and pass &dim to a helper taking CFI_dim_t *; mutation changes the helper type to CFI_cdesc_t *.
pending.cfi-dim-t-lower-bound-member: Assign (CFI_index_t)7 to dim.lower_bound and read it back through a volatile CFI_index_t sink initialized to -99; mutation reads dim.extent instead.
pending.cfi-dim-t-extent-member: Assign (CFI_index_t)3 to dim.extent and read it back through a volatile CFI_index_t sink initialized to -99; mutation reads dim.sm instead.
pending.cfi-dim-t-sm-member: Assign (CFI_index_t)sizeof(double) to dim.sm and read it back through a volatile CFI_index_t sink initialized to -99; mutation reads dim.lower_bound instead.

requirements.title: CFI_dim_t member values describe lower bounds, extents, and byte strides
requirements.source: S18.5.2 p1 member values; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF531.
requirements.definition: For a dimension being described, lower_bound equals the dimension lower bound, extent equals the number of elements or -1 for the final dimension of an assumed-size array, and sm equals the byte stride between addresses of successive elements in that dimension.

pending.cfi-dim-lower-bound-value: Use a Fortran allocatable rank-one actual allocated with lower bound 4 and values [21, 22, 23], pass its descriptor to C, initialize a C sentinel to -99, and assert dim[0].lower_bound changes to 4; mutation expects zero.
pending.cfi-dim-extent-value: Using the same descriptor, initialize a C sentinel to -99 and assert dim[0].extent changes to 3; mutation expects 4.
pending.cfi-dim-assumed-size-final-extent-minus-: Use a future assumed-size descriptor case with an earlier dimension extent two and a final assumed-size dimension; initialize a C sentinel to -99 and assert the final dim extent is -1; mutation expects a positive bound.
pending.cfi-dim-byte-stride-value: Pass a contiguous rank-one double precision actual with elements [2.0, 5.0, 11.0]; C asserts dim[0].sm equals the byte difference between the addresses of elements two and one computed from base_addr and elem_len, with mutation comparing against element count one.

requirements.title: CFI_dim_t may have additional members and any member order
requirements.source: S18.5.2 p1 at-least and order latitude; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF531.
